name: Kitchen Display with Ticket Timers
note: Each ticket's urgency colour is a registered @property <color> driven by one linear CSS animation that is --goal seconds long with a negative delay equal to the ticket's age, so the browser crossfades green to amber to red with no per-frame JS; script only rewrites mm:ss once a second, station bumps strike just that station's items, and survivors FLIP when a ticket leaves the rail. Set --apr-kds-h to 100dvh in an app.

name: Host Stand Floor Plan and Waitlist
note: The floor plan is one drawing measured in cqi of itself, so tables, chairs and labels scale together; dragging a waitlist party (pointer capture, a ghost layer inside the root) grades every table best / ok / no for that party before you let go, and Seat then arrow keys plus Enter does the same from the keyboard. Quotes come from what each fitting table is doing now. Set --apr-floor-h to 100dvh in an app.

name: Online Ordering with Pickup Slots
note: The pickup picker is the kitchen's load chart: each 15-minute slot is a radio whose bar shows dishes already promised, your bag stacks on top, and any slot that cannot take your bag's dish count is disabled with the reason. Dish art is seeded procedural SVG, allergens are recomputed from the chosen protein and add-ons, the category rail is an IntersectionObserver scroll-spy on the menu's own scroller, and cards rise in with animation-timeline: view(). Set --apr-order-h to 100dvh in an app.

name: Reservations Book with Cover Pacing
note: Pacing bars, the time axis and every table row share one column grid through subgrid, so a booking lines up with the covers it adds; while a booking is dragged (pointer capture, snapped to 15 minutes, re-parented into whichever row is under the pointer) the pacing chart is recomputed from the moved copy and the bar turns hatched red when it clashes or the table is too small. Arrow keys move and Shift+arrows resize the focused booking. Set --apr-book-h to 100dvh in an app.

name: Recipe Costing and Menu Pricing
note: Every cost is purchase price ÷ yield × edible portion, and prep recipes are ingredients too, so editing the red wine jus re-prices every dish that ladles it; inputs update numbers in place (never rebuilt while you type) and the composition bar is the table drawn, one flex segment per row whose flex-grow is its cost in cents, so shares re-flow with a spring. Suggested price follows the target food-cost slider and rounding rule; the what-if slider previews a supplier price change before saving it. Set --apr-cost-h to 100dvh in an app.

name: End-of-Day Cash Up
note: All money is integer cents: the float is built greedily from the smallest denominations up (an accent tick in each stack marks what stays), tip shares are split by role points with largest-remainder rounding so they always sum to the pool to the cent, and the paper Z report on the right reprints and flashes every line that changed. Sign-off is a press-and-hold button whose fill is a registered @property transition; releasing early cancels, from pointer or keyboard. Set --apr-cashup-h to 100dvh in an app.

name: Split the Check by Seat or Item
note: Drag an item from the check onto a guest to give it to them, drop it on a second guest and it becomes shared, drag a share between guests or back to the check; pie glyphs are conic-gradients showing each guest's fraction. Items, tax and even splits are all divided in cents with largest-remainder rounding, so guest totals always add back up to the printed check, and once anyone pays their share locks and the split mode cannot change. Set --apr-split-h to 100dvh in an app.

name: Delivery Dispatch with Courier Map
note: Couriers ride Manhattan routes on an SVG street grid and every ETA in the queue, on the pins and in the assignment suggestions comes from the same route lengths at each courier's speed, on a service clock running 30× real time; picking an order ranks couriers by the ETA they would actually deliver it at and what it adds to the bag they already carry. One requestAnimationFrame loop moves riders by setting transforms only, pauses off screen or in a hidden tab, and steps once a second under reduced motion. Set --apr-dispatch-h to 100dvh in an app.
